describe.description: A stout quadrupedal creature shown in right-facing side view standing on a small patch of bare ground with sparse green tufts. It has a broad, flat, axolotl-like head with a wide mouth and large eyes, a pale wrinkled underbelly and limbs, and a dorsal covering of large overlapping brown-gray scales that extends from the top of the head across the entire back and sides and onto a broad, flat, paddle-shaped tail. Six dark stalk-like external gills with dense reddish feathery filaments protrude from the neck just behind the head, three on each side. The body is low-slung on four short thick legs that end in clawed feet.
